reason: Disabling JavaScript in a context, which Firefox can't emulate (emulation.javaScript), so the context can't be made with JavaScript off there

Emulating a touch screen with a mobile viewport in a context, which Chromium supports and Firefox and stock WebKit don't (emulation.touch and emulation.viewport.mobile), so the context can't be made there
A device scale factor other than 1 for a context's viewport, which stock WebKit refuses with Unsupported (emulation.viewport.mobile and its scale), so the context can't be made there
A mobile viewport in a context (isMobile), which Firefox and stock WebKit refuse with Unsupported (emulation.viewport.mobile), so the context can't be made there
